note: Market semantics = Kalshi contract rules text (rules_primary, rules_secondary, early_close_condition, settlement fields) with capture timestamps. MEASURED read-only from the owner's public data branches (git tree listings and single-file reads; nothing written, no credential). 'Captured' means timestamped text is present in an archive; it does NOT mean the capture covers every contract family an archetype needs or that any parser was blind-verified. Semantics completeness stays 0 until a reviewed, blind-verified semantics extraction exists.

states.CAPTURED_UNVERIFIED: timestamped full-text snapshots plus deltas exist in the owner's archive; contract-family coverage and clause extraction not audited
states.PARTIAL_CAPTURE_UNVERIFIED: timestamped text exists for only some contract series; short history
states.NOT_CAPTURED: no archive known to hold timestamped rules text for this sport (the public API serves current text only)

public_api_limits: the market object carries only its CURRENT text (no revision history is exposed); a timestamped history exists only from the first capture. One anonymous GET of 3 open NBA markets on 2026-11-10 confirmed the field set.
kalshi_terms_note: Kalshi API / market-data terms were not read in this phase. Rules text is used only as internal settlement metadata.
